summary: CID HoldCo filed an 8-K on September 25, 2026, disclosing a Securities Purchase Agreement to acquire 100% of BladeRanger Ltd.'s subsidiary Envoy Technologies for 10,833,333 shares valued at $65 million, based on a $6.00 reference price. Consideration includes 233,543 common shares (9.99% pre-closing) and Series C Convertible Preferred, with an Envoy noteholder receiving 2,166,667 preferred shares upon joinder. The preferred is non-voting, converts one-for-one subject to a 19.99% blocker until stockholder approval, and carries a liquidation preference. Watch for stockholder approval timing and potential overhang.
